result.summary: The food delivery home screen is largely well-designed, but the horizontal restaurant carousel ('Fastest near you') clips the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') at the right edge without a clear scroll affordance, and the category filter row is similarly cut off. These are minor visual/UX polish issues; no critical breakage found.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right screen edge, with its title truncated mid-word and no visible scroll indicator or peek-shadow to signal that the row is horizontally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle right-edge fade/gradient or partial-card peek plus a scroll hint so users understand the row scrolls horizontally; ensure card titles use ellipsis truncation rather than hard clipping.

issues.description: The category filter chip row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') is clipped at the right edge with a partially visible chip, giving no visual cue that more categories exist.
issues.suggestion: Add a horizontal scroll indicator, edge fade, or chevron to communicate additional filter options are available off-screen.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right has a red dot badge but no visible text label or apparent accessible name, and the badge state may not be announced to screen readers.
issues.suggestion: Provide an accessibility label (e.g., 'Notifications, 1 new') and ensure the badge count is exposed to assistive technology.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' card images bleed edge-to-edge while the 'Fastest near you' cards have rounded corners and padding, creating a slightly inconsistent card treatment between sections.
issues.suggestion: Unify card corner radius, padding, and image framing across sections for a more cohesive visual system.
